title: The pieces of ferrocene
caption: Ferrocene, Fe(C₅H₅)₂, is a sandwich: an iron(II) ion between two cyclopentadienide rings. Each aromatic C₅H₅⁻ ring donates six π electrons, and Fe²⁺ (d⁶) brings six, giving the stable 18-electron count.
alt: Two cyclopentadienide anions and an iron(II) ion, the components of ferrocene.
description: Two C₅H₅⁻ rings, each aromatic with six π electrons.
Fe²⁺ (d⁶), held between them in ferrocene: 6 + 6 + 6 = 18 electrons.
